title: Holidays
description: Days without school: no menu, no orders, nothing billed.

generate.title: Generate holidays for school year {year}?
generate.body: US federal holidays are computed by rule and added when they fall on a school day between {start} and {end}. Holidays already present, disabled or deleted are never re-created.
generate.moroccan_on: Moroccan fixed-date holidays will also be generated.
generate.moroccan_off: Moroccan holidays are not generated (setting off).

moroccan.label: Also generate Moroccan fixed-date holidays
moroccan.hint: Religious holidays (Eid, Mawlid…) move every year: add them by hand.
moroccan.admin_only: Only an administrator can change this setting.

form.create_title: Add a holiday or a break
form.name: Name
form.range_hint: A range creates one holiday per school day (weekends and days outside the school year are skipped).
form.locked_dates: Generated or imported days keep their dates: disable or delete them instead.
form.days: {count, plural, one {# school day} other {# school days}}

delete.title: Delete “{name}”?
delete.body_manual: This holiday added by hand will be removed.
delete.body_generated: It will be hidden and never re-created by generation or import. To get it back, add it by hand.

impact.confirm: {count, plural, one {# order exists} other {# orders exist}} on these dates. They will be cancelled (reason: holiday) and the parents notified.
impact.title: Orders affected

list.name: Name
list.empty_body: Generate the school year's holidays, add breaks or import the school calendar.
list.count: {count, plural, =0 {No entries} one {# entry} other {# entries}}

errors.end_before_start: The end date must be after the start date.
errors.range_too_long: A range cannot be longer than {max} days.
errors.no_school_day: No school day in these dates (weekend or outside the school year).
errors.duplicate: A holiday with this name already exists on this date.

flash.created: {count, plural, one {Holiday added.} other {# holidays added.}}
flash.disabled: Holiday disabled: it is a school day again.
flash.deleted: {count, plural, one {Holiday deleted.} other {# holidays deleted.}}
flash.generated: {year}: {created, plural, =0 {no new holiday} one {# holiday created} other {# holidays created}}, {skipped} already present, disabled or deleted.
flash.moroccan_off: Moroccan holidays will no longer be generated.

import.title: Import an ICS calendar
import.instructions: Import the school calendar (.ics). All-day events become ranges; only school days of the {label} school year are saved. Nothing is saved until you confirm.
import.url_hint: The school publishes no online calendar for now; prefer the file import.
import.preview_body: Tick the ranges to import. Ranges already imported or overlapping an existing holiday are unticked.

ignored.timed: timed event (only all-day events are imported)

import.truncated: The file has too many events: only the first ones are shown.
import.empty: No all-day events in the school year.
import.confirm: Import {count, plural, =0 {the selection} one {# range} other {# ranges}}
import.done: Import done: {ranges, plural, =0 {no range} one {# range} other {# ranges}}, {created} day(s) added, {skipped} already present.
import.expired: This preview has expired. Import the file again.

file_errors.not_ics: This file is not an ICS calendar.
file_errors.too_many_events: The calendar has too many events.
file_errors.too_many_occurrences: The calendar has too many repeated occurrences.
file_errors.too_complex: The calendar is too complex to read.
file_errors.busy: Another calendar is being read. Try again in a moment.

url_errors.forbidden_port: Only the standard port 443 is accepted.
url_errors.credentials: The address must not contain credentials.
url_errors.bad_status: The server did not return the calendar.
url_errors.too_large: The downloaded calendar is too large.
url_errors.timeout: The server took too long to answer.

import.too_many_days: Too many days to import at once (maximum {max}): untick some ranges.
